description: A modular, stack-agnostic toolkit for AI coding agents to autonomously find, reproduce, and patch vulnerabilities.

written.description: Reads a codebase and its commit history, builds a threat model from them, and sends agents to chase each hypothesis it raises. It then tries to reproduce each finding in a sandbox and attacks its own patch to check the fix holds, working from source alone with no running target.

alive.last_commit_message:
Move the skills into skills/

Nineteen mantis-* directories at the top of the repository, next to
action/ and reference/, hid the shape of the project: a set of skills
and a harness that runs them. They now live under skills/, which is
also the layout `npx skills add` is built around, with a README that
lists each one and what it does. reference/skills/ stays where it is:
those two configure and launch the reference harness and belong with it.

Nothing executes differently. The harness maps a node's skill name to a
built-in prompt and never reads SKILL.md, so neither the pipeline nor
the action is touched. Updated: the anchoring hook's file pattern, the
anchoring script's default glob, one glob in the regression suite, the
integrity test's glob plus a check that the index lists exactly the
skills present (scripts/gen_skills_index.py regenerates it), and the
paths in AGENTS.md and README_AGENTS.md. Links between skills are
relative and unchanged. The top-level README gains three lines saying
what each directory is.

Change-Id: I9dc821aaac385212e9d4f35d218e47a82f1b331b
